mcqs.question: The Production Gap Report 2025 was released on which date by which group of organisations?
options: 22 September 2025 by Stockholm Environment Institute, Climate Analytics and IISD
22 September 2025 by Stockholm Environment Institute and Climate Analytics only
22 September 2025 by Climate Analytics and IISD only
22 September 2025 by Stockholm Environment Institute and IISD only
mcqs.explanation: The Production Gap Report 2025 was released on 22 September 2025 by the Stockholm Environment Institute, Climate Analytics and IISD, with UN support. The other options omit one of the three organisations involved in its release.
